Maya: Heads-up — Marketing launched a promo for the Gamma preview. We just got +52 enrollments this morning. Need an ops + enablement play to avoid a churn spike. Can folks take quick roles?
Owen: Do we have seat assignments / trial tiers for the new signups? any backlog?
Lia: I exported the intake sheet -> https://tools.redwoodinference.io/sheets/gamma-enrollments (filter: new_promo). 52 rows, ~20 flagged "needs onboarding".
Maya: Thanks Lia. Primary risks: 1) people never start (activation), 2) early quality issues -> churn, 3) capacity for dedicated walkthroughs. Proposing rapid playbook:
- Triage first 24h: auto-email + 1 brief kickoff for flagged accounts
- Week 0 office hours (3x 1hr slots spread across TZs)
- Week 1 targeted enablement 1:1 for high-value accounts
Owen: I can own triage for EMEA mornings. Will check capacity with CS rota.
Derek: Agreed re quality signals. Let's add a small NPS/pulse after first 3 interactions. If score <=6 -> escalate to QL check and CSM outreach.
Alex: I'll spin up a one-pager and a short demo gif for "first 10 mins" onboarding. Template subject for outreach:
```
Subject: Quick help getting started with your Gamma preview
Hi {{first_name}}, congrats on getting access — we'd love to see what you build. Can we schedule a 15m intro? If not, here's a 1min help GIF: [link]
```
Maya: Also want a short pulse survey we can auto-send at day 3. Suggested 3 Qs in a single message:
1) Did you get value from initial runs? (Yes/No)
2) What blocked you? (free text)
3) Would you like a <15m call? (Yes/No)
Lia: I'll wire the pulse into the cohort automation (workflow id: gamma-pulse-v2). Adding tags: `activation-risk`, `needs-1on1`.
engage-bot: Survey created: gamma-pulse-v2 (scheduled day 3). Link: https://engage.redwoodinference.io/surveys/gamma-pulse-v2
Derek: For renewal risk, flag accounts with: low usage (<3 sessions/week) + negative pulse + no demo scheduled -> escalate to renewal retention lane.
Alex: Volunteers for office hours? I can run US slots Tue/Thu.
Owen: EMEA morning cover here. Maya, can you take APAC overlap?
Maya: Yep I'll do APAC. Final ask: can everyone drop short status updates in this thread by EOD so I can compile the playbook for tomorrow's ops call? :thumbsup:
Alex: will do.
Lia: updating sheet now.
Derek: adding the escalation criteria to playbook doc.
Maya: Great — thanks team. We'll iterate as enrollments flow; if any urgent churn flags ping me directly. :rocket:
